transform_convention: Rotate original STL about +Z counterclockwise by angle_deg (right-handed), then translate by dx_mm,dy_mm,dz_mm; scale=1. Z unchanged. Plate origin is front-left0,0.

clearance_policy.process_assumption: brim_width=5mm, brim_object_gap=0.1mm, no skirt; this geometry-only sample requires review of local supports. Local support toolpaths have not been sliced or verified and must fit inside the reserved envelope.

heuristic: convex hulls over all Z, no nesting in holes; greedy no-fit polygon search, rotations0/90/180/270; no claim global optimum
